deploymentEvidence.evidence: Official Shiba Inu documentation search-index retrieval identifies this exact Router under Ethereum mainnet for ShibaSwap V1. Direct docs.shib.io requests returned HTTP 530 during review. Independently fetched Ethereum Etherscan address page labels the same exact target ShibaSwap v1: Router, links shibaswap.com, and identifies creator Shiba Inu: Deployer 2. No BSC address or deployment is admitted.
deploymentEvidence.retrievalMethod: Official documentation via indexed web search; Ethereum deployment page fetched directly.

abiEvidence.evidence: ABI parsed directly from the js-copytextarea2 element of this exact Ethereum address page. Etherscan reports Source Code Verified (Exact Match), contract name UniswapV2Router02, compiler v0.6.12+commit.27d51765, optimization 5000 runs. The ABI and reviewed source were fetched from this address, not imported from a Uniswap fork ABI or an unrelated deployment.
abiEvidence.retrievalMethod: Fetch HTML and JSON-decode HTML-unescaped pre#js-copytextarea2. Decode editor_contractJsonData for verified Solidity source.
abiEvidence.proxy: No proxy indirection in the reviewed verified router source: immutable factory and WETH; direct implementation. This is explorer-source review, not independent current-runtime attestation.

reviewSummary.selectedScope: Six ordinary exact-input/exact-output swaps, three fee-on-transfer exact-input swaps, four ordinary add/remove-liquidity actions, and one fee-on-transfer token/ETH liquidity removal.
reviewSummary.excludedScope: Seven view/pure getters/quotes and three LP permit/signature variants. Full verified ABI has no administrative, opaque executor or multicall function.

nonFunctionEntries.reason: Deployment-only constructor is not a callable function capability.
No selector; source restricts receipt to immutable WETH. Not a function capability or direct-ETH-transfer admission.

reviewSummary.securityReview: Reviewed exact address-bound router Solidity body: immutable factory/WETH, ensure(deadline), explicit typed swaps/liquidity, derived pair targets, no opaque arbitrary-call execution. Permit variants excluded independently. No live RPC, bytecode comparison, simulation, balance or liquidity verification performed.
reviewSummary.limitations: Official docs direct requests returned HTTP 530; official chain/address mapping was obtained from indexed search and independently corroborated by the exact Ethereum Etherscan deployment label, verified ABI/source and constructor arguments. No BSC search result was used.
reviewSummary.metadataOnly: This source artifact does not change runtime catalog, API-key grants or independent safety controls.
